notes: NEW PROTOCOL (user decision 2026-10-03): the clean TRAIN30 environment v13 with exactly two changes. (1) Doctor backbone: google/gemma-3-12b-it -> openai/gpt-6.1-sol (the only frontier-grade model already configured in the repo; OpenRouter; temperature 0.4 and max_tokens of v13). (2) Turn order: Agent-first (A1, D1, A2, D2, ..., A7, final); the Doctor gives no diagnosis before A1 and sees the whole case information (the Agent's information) and the conversation. Consequences of (2) in the prompts: the Doctor's system prompt says the consultant opens and asks for critical evaluation (prompts/agentclinic/doctor_agentfirst_v1.txt); the consultant's system prompt no longer says the Doctor lacks the examination and test findings (prompts/agentclinic/consultant_agentfirst_v1.txt); the Agent's first turn has an opening task (protocol.AGENT_FIRST_OPENING). Agent Qwen3-4B, split TRAIN30/DEV31/TEST60, max 7 turns with early stopping, the judge (gpt-4o-mini, majority-v1; the v13 mapping copied here and extended by the same policy) unchanged. No D1 history exists in this protocol: histories.jsonl holds an empty prefix per case. Nothing of the v13 runs (trajectories, failures, R_0, labels, predictor) is reused.
